name: Polylink Polymers (India) Limited
about: Polylink Polymers (India) Limited primarily manufactures and sells polymeric compounds and colour masterbatches in India, Turkey, Georgia, Bangladesh, Thailand, Nigeria, and internationally. The company offers power, XLPE, and telecommunication cables.; and filler, black, white, color, and additive masterbatches. Its products are used in agriculture, water conveying and storage, consumer and household goods, textile and fibers, wires and cables, rigid and flexible packaging, plastic processing, and building and construction sectors. Polylink Polymers (India) Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
